title: Best Ecommerce Platform 2026: 5 platforms tested with a real DTC store
description: Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Wix eCommerce, Squarespace Commerce — same DTC apparel store with 800 SKUs migrated to each. Conversion rate, page-load speed, transaction fees, and which platforms scale beyond $5M annual revenue.
lede: Five ecommerce platforms. Same DTC apparel store with 800 SKUs and $1.2M annual revenue. We migrated each, tracked conversion rate, page-load speed, total transaction costs, and which platforms scale beyond $5M revenue.
methodology: Same store: 800 SKUs, $1.2M annual GMV, 60% mobile traffic. Migrated to each platform. Ran 60 days. Tracked conversion rate, page-load speed (Lighthouse), transaction fees, app costs, and admin time per week.

sections.heading: Conversion rate
paragraphs: Conversion rate by platform (60-day test, same products, same prices): Shopify 2.8%, BigCommerce 2.6%, WooCommerce 2.4% (depends heavily on theme/hosting), Wix eCommerce 2.1%, Squarespace Commerce 2.3%.
Shopify wins on conversion partly due to Shop Pay (one-click checkout), partly due to mobile UX optimization, partly due to app ecosystem (reviews, upsells, cart abandonment).
WooCommerce's variance is significant — a well-built WooCommerce site (clean theme, fast hosting like Cloudways or Kinsta) can match Shopify. A poorly-configured one underperforms.

sections.heading: Total cost at $1.2M revenue
paragraphs: Annual platform + payment + app costs at $1.2M GMV: Shopify Advanced $4,800 + Shop Payments 1.85% × 1.2M ≈ $27,000 + apps $2,400 ≈ $34,200/yr. BigCommerce Pro $4,800 + payment processor 2.5% × 1.2M ≈ $30,000 + apps $1,200 ≈ $36,000/yr.
WooCommerce: $0 platform + hosting $1,200 + payment processor 2.5-2.9% × 1.2M ≈ $30,000-35,000 + plugins/maintenance $3,000 ≈ $34,200-39,200/yr.
Wix eCommerce: $432 + payment processor 2.9% × 1.2M ≈ $34,800 + apps $600 ≈ $35,832/yr. Squarespace Commerce: $588 + Squarespace Payments 2.9% × 1.2M ≈ $34,800 + apps $300 ≈ $35,688/yr.
Shopify wins on total cost at $1.2M+ revenue due to lower transaction fees through Shop Payments. Beyond $5M revenue, the gap widens further.

sections.heading: Scaling past $5M revenue
paragraphs: Shopify Advanced → Shopify Plus ($2,500-15,000+/mo) scales smoothly to $100M+. Most US DTC brands over $10M revenue are on Shopify Plus.
BigCommerce Enterprise scales to similar levels with multi-storefront capabilities. Strong for B2B + DTC combined operations.
WooCommerce can scale technically but requires dedicated DevOps headcount. The $5M+ inflection often pushes WooCommerce stores to Shopify Plus.
Wix and Squarespace plateau around $5M revenue. Beyond that, they're outgrown.

faqs.a: Shopify for DTC and most use cases — best app ecosystem, best mobile UX, lowest transaction fees with Shop Payments. BigCommerce for B2B (multi-storefront, complex catalogs), no-transaction-fee preference, or API-first development.
The plugin is free. Total cost: hosting ($30-100/mo) + theme ($60-200 one-time) + premium plugins ($100-500/yr). Reaches Shopify pricing at scale; the value is in flexibility and ownership.
Wix for design-focused stores under 100 SKUs. Squarespace if you already use Squarespace for content and want ecommerce as a secondary function. Both plateau at higher scale.
Shopify Hydrogen, BigCommerce headless, Saleor — viable for teams with React/Next.js skills. Setup cost is significant ($50k+); reach for headless only at $5M+ revenue with technical advantages.

shopify-advanced.review: Shopify Advanced is the right pick for most ecommerce stores. Best app ecosystem (10,000+ apps), Shop Pay one-click checkout boosts conversion, lowest transaction fees at top tier. Scales smoothly to Shopify Plus. The default recommendation for DTC.

bigcommerce-pro.review: BigCommerce Pro is the right pick for B2B + DTC combined operations. Multi-storefront, complex catalog support, no transaction fees. API-first architecture for headless development. Less ideal for pure DTC than Shopify.

woocommerce-wordpress.review: WooCommerce is the right pick for teams that want flexibility and ownership. Open-source, integrates with WordPress, no platform fees. Hosting + theme + plugins reach Shopify pricing at scale. Best when you want to own and customize everything.

wix-ecommerce-business.review: Wix eCommerce Business is the right pick for design-focused stores under 100 SKUs. Strong drag-and-drop UX, AI website generator, $36/mo Business. Plateaus around $1-2M revenue.

squarespace-commerce-advanced.review: Squarespace Commerce Advanced is the right pick if you already use Squarespace for content and want ecommerce as a secondary function. Strong design + content + commerce integration. Better as content-first sites adding commerce, less ideal as pure ecommerce.
cons: Less powerful than Shopify for pure ecommerce

offerNotes.shopify-advanced: Sign up at shopify.com — 3-day free trial, then $1/mo for 3 months.
offerNotes.bigcommerce-pro: Sign up at bigcommerce.com — 15-day free trial.
offerNotes.woocommerce-wordpress: Free plugin at woocommerce.com — requires WordPress hosting.
offerNotes.wix-ecommerce-business: Sign up at wix.com — Business plan from $27/mo.
offerNotes.squarespace-commerce-advanced: Sign up at squarespace.com — 14-day free trial.
